svg.title: The comments of a contribution
svg.desc: Someone other than Dennis or a bot comments on an issue or a pull request of someone else. A comment on one of Dennis or of a bot, the same comment again and an ignored thing end there. A thing that is open names the comment in its message, edited in place, and one message below it in its topic notifies, once for a few quick comments; a draft that Dennis asked for is written again for the comment, while a text that he wrote himself stays the draft. A thing whose reply went, or that GitHub dealt with, opens again in its topic with Draft a reply, and an issue that the pager never showed comes as a new thing. When Dennis comments on GitHub itself, or the issue or the pull request closes, the thing is done: its buttons go, and its topic gets a check mark.
